uri.description: A MongoDB connection string, mongodb:// or mongodb+srv://. The destination reads from the primary whatever its read preference and read concern, and writes with its write concern, majority in place of w=0; w=1 lets a failover roll back a committed epoch.
uri.title: Connection string

database.description: The database collections are written to when the pipeline names no namespace.
database.title: Database

extendedJSONKeys.description: Write each string key as the _id the MongoDB source read it from, with its BSON type: 24 hex digits as an ObjectId, and anything else as canonical Extended JSON, which is how that source spells _id. A key in neither form fails the write. For pipelines from the MongoDB source. False: a string key is a string _id.
extendedJSONKeys.title: Keys as Extended JSON
